verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs show it generates invoices and can auto-issue them after grace periods, or hold them as drafts for manual approval. It also recalculates affected invoices automatically when late data arrives. The rest of the story (credit notes, receipts, numbering, custom fields, memos, delivery to customers) has no evidence; the proration credit in orb-docs-16 is a customer credit, not a documented credit-note document. Missing for 10: credit note generation, receipts, sequential numbering, custom fields, memos, automatic delivery of documents to customers (e.g. email), tax/compliance details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Invoices auto-issue after grace periods and buffers
Require manual approval: Remain in draft until manually issued via the dashboard or API
